tool_choice.critique: The agent read the docs README and the helper --help. It then used the tested helper iqm_run.py with list, run, and result. These tools fit the task. The agent took no detours.

arguments.critique: The agent made one submission. It used alias sirius, 100 shots, and a 2-qubit QASM file with h q[0], cx q[0],q[1], and two measures. The grader confirms right_qpu, right_shots, right_qubit_count, and circuit_correct_sim.

when_to_call.critique: The agent ran list before it submitted. The list showed that sirius was healthy and online with an empty queue. The agent did not call arch or calib. The helper run command transpiles for sirius with MOVE awareness, so the agent did not need loci by hand. The agent acted on no assumption that the API could have checked and that turned out to matter.

when_not_to_call.critique: The task authorized one real job on sirius. The agent submitted exactly one job. It made no repeated identical calls. The grader shows no_unrequested_real_jobs and job_count_ok as true.

multi_step.critique: The agent printed job ID 01a15fb4-aa72-7599-8251-3f16bd54130d right after the submit. It passed the same ID to result and to the final report. No ID or result was mixed up.

efficiency.critique: The metrics show 7 tool calls. Those are 1 Read, 5 Bash, and 1 StructuredOutput. The T6 minimum is 4, so the limit is 8. The agent stayed under that limit.
